name: Bell Mountain
source:
Your two best friends force you into a test of courage inside the old college campus. Unknown to everyone, a ghostly woman stalks the hallways. Soon you realize you are on an endless venture to save yourself.

[From [url=https://justaaronart.itch.io/bell-mountain]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你的两个最好的朋友迫使你在旧大学校园内进行勇气测试。所有人都不知道，一个幽灵般的女人在走廊里徘徊。很快你就会意识到，为了拯救自己，你正在进行一场永无休止的冒险。

[来自[url=https://justaaronart.itch.io/bell-mountain]Itch.io[/url]]
